ai_summary: A2Z Infra Engineering Limited reported a Q1 2026 net loss of Rs. 23.77 lakhs, but the statutory auditors issued a disclaimer of conclusion on the financial results. This disclaimer is driven by significant going concern uncertainties, including substantial accumulated losses (over Rs. 1,07,000 lakhs), negative net worth, acute liquidity problems, and numerous debt recovery actions. Materially, the company has also not recognized approximately Rs. 218.46 lakhs in interest expenses for the quarter on non-performing asset (NPA) borrowings, which understates its liabilities.
